item.title: commandline: What will the next generation of developers do when AI writes the code?
item.description:
Microsoft and Carnegie Mellon University suggest that junior developers trained today will become the senior engineers working alongside AI-assisted coding tools in the future. The piece frames AI as part of software engineering training rather than a replacement for developers.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
